title: AlphaFold-based interaction prediction guides selective DGKI demethylation in glioblastoma
summary: AlphaFold-based protein-protein interaction prediction was combined with sequential ChIP and DNMT1 interactome data to show that a DNMT1/ELK1 complex regulates DGKI methylation. A peptide (EXD-DNMT1/ELK1) induced selective DGKI demethylation and restored temozolomide sensitivity in cellular and patient-derived xenograft models. AlphaFold is one step in an integrative approach; preclinical, with numerical results not read.
organization: École Nationale Supérieure de Chimie de Montpellier; Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique; Institut des Biomolécules Max Mousseron

evidence.unknown: Numerical effect sizes; clinical translation; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold predicted the DNMT1/ELK1 interaction used to design the peptide.
